description: This file defines an Android activity named Regions that demonstrates the use of the Region class and various set operations on graphical regions within a custom View called SampleView. It includes methods for drawing rectangles, creating regions, and rendering different region operations such as UNION, XOR, DIFFERENCE, and INTERSECT on the canvas.

classes.name: Regions
classes.description: An Android activity that showcases graphical region operations using a custom view.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass used to demonstrate the creation and rendering of regions with various set operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: drawOriginalRects
methods.description: Draws two predefined rectangles with specified alpha transparency on the canvas.

methods.name: drawRgn
methods.description: Creates a region from two rectangles using a specified operation, and draws the resulting region along with optional label text.

methods.name: drawCentered
methods.description: Draws a rectangle centered around its bounds, accounting for stroke width.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the entire sample, drawing multiple regions with different set operations.
